name: CLOUD-04 登录失效 → 备份 401 → 转仅本地模式，不抛异常、BLE 不受影响

setup.code: const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; if (!c) throw new Error('cloud-mock 未注入'); c.reset(); c.setScenario({ login: { responses: [{ status: 401, body: { error: { code: 'AUTH_INVALID' } } }] }, refresh: { responses: [{ status: 401, body: { error: { code: 'AUTH_INVALID', message: 'refresh revoked' } } }] }, put: { responses: [{ status: 401, body: { error: { code: 'AUTH_INVALID', message: 'access revoked' } } }] } }); wx.clearStorageSync(); const token = c.issueToken({ ttlMs: 3600e3 }); wx.setStorageSync('cloudSession', JSON.stringify({ accessToken: token, refreshToken: 'e2e-refresh-old', user: null, savedAt: Date.now() })); const app = getApp(); return { loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), usable: app.cloudAuth.hasUsableAccess() };

steps.code: const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; const d = p.data.devices[0]; if (!d) throw new Error('设备列表为空：扫描未发现 ML-8DCC'); return p.onTapDevice({ currentTarget: { dataset: { deviceId: d.deviceId, name: d.name } } });
const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { route: p.route, deviceId: p.data.deviceId, connected: !!p.data.connected, error: p.data.error || '' };

const app = getApp(); const c = globalThis.__cloudMock; const deadline = Date.now() + 8000; while (Date.now() < deadline) { if (app.cloudSync.isLocalOnly()) break; await new Promise((r) => setTimeout(r, 100)); } const st = c.getState(); const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { counts: st.counts, last: st.last, localOnly: app.cloudSync.isLocalOnly(), loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), session: wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession') || null, connected: !!(p && p.data.connected) };

assertions.code: const app = getApp(); const pages = getCurrentPages(); const p = pages[pages.length - 1]; return { localOnly: app.cloudSync.isLocalOnly(), loggedIn: app.cloudAuth.isLoggedIn(), hasSession: !!wx.getStorageSync('cloudSession'), connected: !!(p && p.data.connected) };
